lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: This is the DTE Energy disconnection department calling for Margaret Hale.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Your account shows a past-due bill of $412.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: That doesn't sound right. My bill is usually under a hundred dollars.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: A technician is scheduled to shut off your power in 45 minutes unless it is paid.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: The only way to stop it today is to pay with gift cards. Buy four $100 cards at the nearest store and read me the numbers.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Stay on the phone with me while you drive there, and don't tell the cashier what the cards are for.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: I think I should call DTE myself first.
